stem: A technician finds suspicious leaves in a clean room and wants a coworker in another room to inspect them. What is the best approach?
choices: Carry the leaves through the facility uncovered
Follow the sampling/photo and escalation procedure while limiting unnecessary material movement between rooms
Place the leaves on a shared cart
Leave the finding undocumented until the coworker is available
rationale: Scouting should preserve biosecurity. Evidence can be documented or sampled through controlled procedures without creating a new contamination pathway.
